name: targeted-debug-skill-evals
description: Pin the hard scope rules (no broad exploration, no MCP, no /investigate auto-launch).

cases.description: extract-error-paths.sh must extract Java/Scala/JS/Python file paths from a mixed stack trace and emit them deduplicated.

input.command: bash .claude/skills/targeted-debug/scripts/extract-error-paths.sh 'at com.example.Foo.bar(Foo.scala:42) and File "/repo/src/app.py", line 87, in main'

cases.description: The skill MUST NOT call any mcp__pm-mcp__* tool. The frontmatter allowed-tools list excludes all MCP tools as a structural enforcement.
cases.assert: 0 — only references to MCP appear in 'do NOT call MCP' rule text, never as allowed tools

cases.description: The skill body MUST NOT contain language that suggests auto-invoking /investigate.
Every targeted-debug report MUST end with 'Out-of-scope follow-ups' so users have an explicit escalation path.
Given vague input ('something is broken'), the skill must stop and ask for concrete evidence — not start reading files.

input.prompt: Something is broken with bookings, can you look?

cases.assert: skill responds by asking for stack trace / error / file, NOT by starting to read files
